title: Monotonicity of the chain cursor
statement: For every Boolean literal $h$, every finite list $R$ of Boolean literals, and every natural number $n$, the cursor returned by the clause-splitting chain starting at $h$, with remainder $R$ and cursor $n$, is at least $n$.
replaced:
For every head literal, remaining clause, and starting cursor $n$, the cursor
returned by the chain construction is at least $n$: the fresh-variable allocator
never moves backwards.
